preconditions.description: The number of distinct integers n is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The number of points k is at least 0 and at most 10^8.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output is a list of n distinct integers and each integer is at most 10^9)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if no such sequence exists, or a list of n distinct integers where each integer is at most 10^9.
